title: TOURNAMENT PRIZE BREAKDOWN
html:
DC Metro Tournament Prize Payouts

TOURNAMENT PRIZE BREAKDOWN

DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour
How Tournament Prizes Work

Flight Prize Pool

At each tournament, a portion of the tournament entry fee will be placed into the prize pool for each flight.

Prize amounts vary based on number of participants in each flight.

Prize Pool Adjustments

Prize pools may change on the day of the tournament depending on late entries or player withdrawals.

Final payouts are calculated after the field is finalized.

USGA Amateur Prize Limit

No single prize value may exceed the maximum limit allowed by the USGA Amateur Status Rules.

Maximum prize value allowed: $750

No Cash Prizes

In accordance with amateur golf rules, cash prizes are not permitted.

All prizes are issued as Visa Gift Cards.

Prize Payout Posting

All prize payouts will be posted on the tour website along with tournament results.

Players can review prize payouts with official event results.

Tie Resolution

All ties for First Place will be decided by a sudden death playoff.

All other ties are resolved according to official Tour Guidelines.

Flight Winner Trophy

Every flight winner receives more than just a prize payout.

Each flight champion receives an official tournament trophy.
